annotations.title: Exact-Decimal multi-currency FX, fee/tax basis-point & invoice grand

description: [0.003000 USDC via x402] Eliminates LLM IEEE-754 floating-point drift in financial workflows. Reconciles 1 to 500 ledger or invoice line items using exact base-10 Decimal (ROUND_HALF_UP) arithmetic across FX rates, fee basis points, tax basis points, and credit/debit signs, flagging duplicate IDs and penny variances against expected totals.

decimals.description: Target fractional decimal places for quantized line & grand totals (0 to 8, default 2).

entries.description: List of 1 to 500 ledger or invoice line items to reconcile.

amount.description: Line item gross amount (>= 0 or signed if side omitted).

fee_bps.description: Platform or payment fee in basis points (0 to 10000, default 0; deducted from gross).

fx_rate.description: Multiplier to convert source currency into base_currency (default '1').

tax_bps.description: Additive tax/VAT in basis points (0 to 10000, default 0; added to gross).

expected_net_total.description: Optional expected net grand total to verify exact tie-out (MATCH_EXACT vs DISCREPANCY_DETECTED).

name: reconcile_decimal_ledger
title: Exact-Decimal multi-currency FX, fee/tax basis-point & invoice grand
